name: Gated Linear Attention · GLA
tagline: Use input-dependent forgetting to control matrix memory.
description: A feature-wise gate decays the previous state before the current KV update is added. A low-rank gate projection provides input-dependent forgetting, while a SiLU output gate controls the readout.
paperTitle: Gated Linear Attention Transformers with Hardware-Efficient Training
mechanism: S ← diag(g)S + kvᵀ, followed by a query readout
A rank-16 gate projection and a SiLU output gate
FP32 state, without importing softmax attention’s RoPE or Q/K normalization
limitations: The reference is a readable recurrent scan, not the paper’s hardware-efficient chunked kernel. The completed run uses a separately frozen FLA fused-recurrent backend and an operator-level cost ledger with backward replay; see its evidence and source patch. It does not establish a fused backend in the current code.
